meta.title: Catalogue of Life China 2023 · bird species
meta.scope: China as defined by the CAS source; no independent border, occurrence-status, or Taiwan completeness audit
meta.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (CAS baseline); CC BY 4.0 (IOC 15.2 names; AviList v2026 corrections); CC BY 3.0 (IOC 13.1 historical names)
meta.coverage: All 1,445 accepted species binomials in the downloaded CAS archive. Partial against current China checklists; not a complete 2026 inventory. 48 cards whose names belonged to another bird were corrected against AviList v2026, keeping their IDs.

sources.title: The Biodiversity Committee of CAS, Xu Z (2024). Catalogue of Life China 2023 Annual Checklist. Version 1.1.
Gill F, Donsker D & Rasmussen P (eds). 2026. IOC World Bird List v15.2. GBIF/CoLDP distribution.
Gill F, Donsker D & Rasmussen P (eds). 2023. IOC World Bird List v13.1, multilingual version. Historical English-name fallback.
AviList Core Team. 2026. AviList: The Global Avian Checklist, v2026 (extended version, 20 Oct 2026). Used for reviewed name corrections only.
eBird Taxonomy (Cornell Lab of Ornithology), retrieved 2026-11-18. Common name used for 1 card by the project's choice.
sources.license: Factual common name; no open license asserted
